name: Aishwarya Ray
original_name: アイシュワリヤ・レイ
source:
She is a brown demoness from the demon world. She is said to be the best fortune teller in Amidahara. Also known as Aish.
She controls a group of ruins called "Red Sky Tower," part of the Amidahara Ruins area, and runs gambling matches and a brothel.
The operation is more of a hedonistic hobby than a means to make money, and as an independent force in Amidahara, she maintains a stance of non-aggression and non-interference with the organizations that rule Amidahara.

Her nickname is "Crimson Queen" or "Red Queen".
She is a close friend of Annerose, but at the same time, she is a pervert who loves to torment her.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=680360]Getchu[/url]]
